commit.subject: LU-12669 ec: EC feature test build (DO NOT LAND)
commit.message:
LU-12669 ec: EC feature test build (DO NOT LAND)

A test vehicle, not for landing. It squashes the open changes below,
at the patchsets listed, onto master 40b80bc048 (v2_17_60) so that
they can be built and tested together: every open change with both the
218_review_priority and pt_ecro hashtags as of 2026-10-28, plus the
changes marked * or +. It is refreshed as they get new patchsets.

68361 (LU-20690) stores EC parity as LOV_PATTERN_PARITY and no longer
accepts the RAID0|PARITY encoding of master, so EC files must be
created with this build.

64441 (LU-12187 layout pattern negotiation) is applied after 62868,
which drops the module parameters 64441 negotiates with.  The local
fix after 64441 keeps the negotiation with FLR EC on by default
(enable_flr_ec=1, mdt_enable_flr_ec=1).

64919 ps52 and 69392 both make an EC read that parity cannot rebuild
wait for its stripes' OSTs instead of failing: 64919 changes sanity-ec
test_29a to expect it, and 69392 implements it (cl_io::ci_ec_wait),
with the same test_29a and a new test_29b.

Included, in apply order (change/patchset):
   69349/8   LU-12669 ec: serialize concurrent EC recovery readers
   69350/7   LU-12669 ec: create lock placeholder for reconstructed
             pages
   69702/1   LU-20708 llite: rebuild faulting EC pages from parity
   69694/3   LU-20958 llite: only update blocks after a flush
   64086/48  LU-20958 lov: handle unavailable EC stripes in lseek
   69828/2   LU-20958 llite: drop strict SOM size with the UPDATE lock
   62868/4   LU-12187 llite: enable FLR EC support unconditionally
   69762/7   LU-20287 lov: don't block setattr on unavailable OST
   68747/14  LU-20718 ec: ignore stale EC fields from old servers
   68932/4   LU-20718 lod: scrub stale EC fields from old layouts
   69699/5   LU-20963 lod: use a reconnecting OST only when needed
   66882/41  LU-20211 mdt: trunc(0) layout replace on inactive stripes
 * 69305/6   LU-8933 lod: balance round-robin first stripe start
   69421/5   LU-19823 lod: balance RR allocation across failure
             domains
   69422/3   LU-8933 lod: leave inactive targets out of the RR array
   69426/5   LU-19823 lod: spread failover groups over the RR array
   69697/7   LU-20967 osd-ldiskfs: name the failure_domain local file
   69111/14  LU-20797 llite: add SET I/O scope ioctl
   69516/7   LU-20690 lov: slot-based stripe geometry for EC parity
   69517/9   LU-20690 ec: implement STRIPE I/O scope
   69575/7   LU-20690 utils: add EC parity-stripe I/O helpers
   68361/17  LU-20690 ec: like-RAID10 parity layout
   69703/3   LU-20690 ec: verify parity against data, allow p > k
   69908/1   LU-12669 ec: fix degraded read page leak and short read
 + 69913/1   LU-20708 osc: let read faults switch mirrors on a bad OSC
 + 69914/1   LU-12328 llite: move a failed DIO read to the next mirror
 + 69493/5   LU-19823 lod: unique failure domains per EC raid set
 + 69824/3   LU-20212 obdclass: don't block no-delay statfs on others
 + 69352/3   LU-20200 utils: report unreachable targets in lfs df -l
 + 64919/52  LU-12669 lov: slow and dead OST detection for degraded
             reads
   local     EC feature merge fix: 64919 with 64086 and 68361
 + 69709/2   LU-12669 lov: peer-relative deadline for EC raid set
             reads
   69710/2   LU-12669 lov: split EC reads at a raid set parity cannot
             cover
 + 64441/32  LU-12187 lov: MDS layout pattern negotiation
   local     local: 64441 on 62868: FLR EC on by default, fail_loc
             0x143c
   69392/3   LU-12669 ec: wait for stripes that parity cannot rebuild
 * 69768/4   LU-11962 flr: fix the handling of foreign mirrors
 + 69769/2   LU-11962 flr: fix FLR and SOM state after a layout swap
   70067/1   LU-20690 ec: copy parity in 1+N recovery reads
 + 69916/3   LU-21014 lod: keep EC raid sets on distinct OSTs in RR

* untagged parent of a tagged change
+ untagged, added on request

local = fix for conflicts with master or between the changes, not in
Gerrit.

Conflicts resolved by hand: 69828, 62868, 66882, 69422, 69516, 69517,
68361, 69703, 69908, 69914, 64919, 69709, 69710, 64441, 69392, 69768,
69769.
